headline: Market opens with focus on record IPO activity, strengthening Rupee, and Adani-Sebi settlement

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: The Indian Rupee strengthened to 95.59 following a drop in oil prices and RBI dollar sales.
September recorded a 30-year high in IPO activity with 30 mainboard issues raising Rs 38,785 crore.
RBI has issued warnings to banks regarding potential loan price wars affecting the sector.
Mixed global cues as the Nasdaq hit record highs while the Dow and S&P 500 slipped.
whatHappening: Adani Group settled corporate governance violations with Sebi by paying a Rs 1.5 crore fine.
Internal tensions at Bombay House suggest a potential clash between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts.
Sebi is working to address concerns related to expiry-day derivatives settlement processes.
Credit card issuers are pivoting toward EMI loans to offset the decline in the revolver model.
summary: The Indian market enters trade on September 23 with a focus on a record-breaking IPO rush and a strengthening Rupee. While Adani Group has settled governance issues with Sebi, internal friction within the Tata Group and RBI warnings to banks provide a cautious backdrop. Global volatility and oil prices near $100 continue to influence investor sentiment.
